questions.q: Which film stars a race car named **Lightning McQueen**?
Which superhero is called **The Dark Knight**?
In Jurassic Park, where was the dinosaur **DNA** found?
What colour are Dorothy's **slippers** in the 1939 film?
Which film won the first Oscar for Best **Animated** Feature?

lines.q: Which film stars a race car named Lightning McQueen?
lines.a: Cars! Ka-chow, two thousand and six.

lines.q: Which superhero is called The Dark Knight?
lines.a: Batman! Gotham's very own night shift.

lines.q: In Jurassic Park, where was the dinosaur DNA found?
lines.a: In a mosquito trapped in amber! Clever, right?

lines.q: What colour are Dorothy's slippers in the nineteen thirty nine film?
lines.a: Ruby red! In the book they were silver, but red popped in Technicolor.

lines.q: Which film won the first Oscar for Best Animated Feature?
lines.a: Shrek! It beat Monsters Inc back in two thousand and two.

lines.q: Last one. How many Oscars did Titanic win?
lines.a: Eleven! Tied for the all-time record. Six out of six? Follow if you got it!
